messages:
Mira Singh: Quick update — I finished an initial bring-up of Zephyr-4B on the inference fleet. FP16 baseline looks solid: latency is within our SLO for 2k tokens and cost is reasonable vs our 7B offering. Need to decide quant strategy, finalize model-catalog metadata, and coordinate docs + announcement. PR with raw bench logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/1234

Sam Ortiz: Nice — can you paste the top-line numbers here? throughput, p95, and a quick compare to our 3B/7B baselines?

Mira Singh: Top lines: throughput (tokens/s): 210, p95 latency (1k context): 120ms, ppl (eval set): 16.8. Cost per 1M tokens ~ $2.1 on hosted fp16. Compared to 3B -> 0.6x cost, 7B -> 1.8x cost.

Sam Ortiz: Good. For quant experiments, I'd like a reproducible config. Suggest starting with Q4_0 per-channel + residual-fp16 for heads. Example config I used:
```
quant:
  scheme: Q4_0
  per_channel: true
  residual_fp16: true
  backend: onnxruntime
  eval_metrics: ppl, rouge-l
```
Keep logs and evals attached to the PR.

EvalBot: Automated evals completed for commit abc123. Results: ppl=16.8, rouge-l=0.81 on our standard summarization set. No safety classifier regressions flagged for the smoke set. Regression alerts will be enabled for the zephyr_smoke_v1 promptset.

Alex Chen: Product notes — we need: canonical prompt set, top-10 regen tests, and a few edge-case evals (long-context, instruction-following). Also thinking about the message we show in the Console release notes. @Tara (marketing) we should align on copy and timing.

Jen Park: I'll draft the model-catalog entry. Proposed minimal fields: id: zephyr-4b, family: zephyr, params: 4B, tokenizer: byte-bpe, recommended_configs: [fp16, q4_on_onnx], use_cases: chat, summarization, embedding-compat: false. I'll put the PR up today.

Sam Ortiz: Rollout plan suggestion: canary 5% (24h) -> 25% (24h) -> 100% with automated latency/cost/regression checks. Fallback policy: auto-route to zephyr-3b if p95 > 2x baseline or safety regressions trigger. Also add a dedicated-optimized variant for Dedicated customers that want higher throughput.

Tara (marketing): We can do a short blog post + changelog + console banner. Need one-pager + legal review at least 72h before publish. If product wants Monday launch, we need final copy by Friday EOD.

Nikhil (security): Heads up — run the privacy/data flow scanner and KMS/HSM requirement checklist. Won't block GA but need signoff for Private deployments. Flagging possible tokenization edge cases for PII detection.

Mira Singh: OK action items I will own: finalize quant experiments + attach reproducible evals, open docs PR with quickstart and recommended configs, and open the fleet rollout ticket. Jen: catalog entry. Sam: rollout automation and fallback wiring. Alex: final eval + prompt set. Tara: announcement assets + timeline. Nikhil: security scan. Plan target: tentative announcement Monday 10:00am PT (finalize if legal OK). Anyone object? :eyes:

Alex Chen: LGTM from product.

Jen Park: Catalog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/5678 (draft). I'll include recommended examples for hosted/dedicated/private configs.

EvalBot: Regression alerting for zephyr_smoke_v1 enabled. Thresholds set: ppl delta > 0.8 or rouge-l delta < -0.02 triggers page.

Mira Singh: Great — I'll merge docs and the quant artifact PR tomorrow morning and start the canary. Thanks all :tada:
